Phanteks Innovative Computer Hardware Design

 

Phanteks Revolt Pro power supply.

Wattage

- 850 Watt 
- 1000 Watt 

Features:

Phanteks brings patented technology of the Power Combo to the Revolt PRO power supply. In collaboration with Seasonic, the Revolt Pro is 80 PLUS Gold certified, fully modular, and the very first expandable power supply. The Revolt Pro allows you to connect a secondary power supply to provide increased power output or redundancy to protect your data from power failure. The Revolt PRO makes advanced server features accessible and cost efficient for everyone in a true plug and play manner.
